propositions: Cumulative error counters advance their offset before CloudWatch acknowledges the datapoint, causing transient put-metric-data failures to permanently lose that interval's count

Seven metric streams across six code shapes (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared deferral/interrupt helper, G2P) share the same defective construct of persisting offset before AWS call succeeds
When a targeted AWS metric call fails with exit code 23, the offset advances to the source total, and the next successful run publishes zero instead of the accumulated delta
Offset advancement must be reordered to occur only after successful CloudWatch publication, with failed publishes leaving offsets unchanged for retry on the next interval

The regression test confirms that before repair every stream exhibits the defect (offset 2/source 7 becoming 7 after failed publish, then publishing 0), and after repair the offset remains unchanged and the retry publishes the accumulated delta
